info.name: Opus API
info.description:
Requests for every Opus endpoint.

1. Start the API with demo data: `./mvnw spring-boot:run -Dspring-boot.run.profiles=dev,seed`
2. Run **Auth > Login**. It stores the tokens; all other requests send them automatically.
3. Create requests store the new record's id (productId, customerId, ...) for the requests that follow.

Change `baseUrl`, `email` and `password` under the collection's Variables tab.

request.description: Run this first. Saves the access and refresh tokens to collection variables; every other request uses them.
Access tokens last 15 minutes by default. Run this when requests start returning 401.
Mock tokens work only in the dev and test profiles.
In dev the code arrives in Mailpit at http://localhost:8025.
Revokes all sessions; log in again afterwards.
movementType: INBOUND, OUTBOUND, ADJUSTMENT, RETURN, DAMAGE. A negative delta removes stock.

item.name: Purchase Orders

request.description: Needs supplierId and productId; run the create requests in Suppliers and Products first.
Adds the ordered quantities to stock as INBOUND movements.

item.description: Lifecycle: DRAFT -> ORDERED -> RECEIVED, or CANCELLED before receipt.

item.name: Sales Orders

request.description: Needs customerId and productId; run the create requests in Customers and Products first.
Removes the sold quantities from stock; fails with ERR_422 if stock is insufficient.

item.description: Lifecycle: DRAFT -> CONFIRMED -> FULFILLED, or CANCELLED before fulfilment.
